selected_architecture_note: Structured semantic claim/evidence judge via one Cerebras strict-JSON-schema call. Selected over candidate_a_deterministic (weak baseline, 5/22 dev, 2/5 validation - cannot detect paraphrase/overclaiming/contradiction beyond exact numerals) and candidate_c_hybrid (real, measured defect: the deterministic numeric precheck's word-boundary number extraction is asymmetric between free prose claims and compact enum-style Evidence fields like 'PHASE2'/'CHEMBL941', causing false CONTRADICTED overrides - 16/22 dev after a partial fix, still worse than Candidate B alone; not worth further engineering since B alone reaches 100% dev+validation).
same_model_as_generator_caveat: The frozen Phase-6 generator (candidate_b_structured) and this Phase-7 evaluator (candidate_b_semantic_judge) both use Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b. This is NOT cross-model independent validation - it is a separate evaluation path, isolated from the generator's prompt/context/candidate-identity, validated against independently-authored, Evidence-backed gold labels never seen by the generator.
prompt_version: _SYSTEM_PROMPT v2 (grounding_eval/judge.py) - v2 includes the CONTRADICTED-vs-PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED clarification added after a real dev-split defect (see phase7_failure_analysis.json)
label_taxonomy_version: grounding_eval/models.py::SupportLabel v1 (4 labels), CitationRelation v1 (4 relations)
numeric_check_logic: NOT part of the selected architecture (Candidate A/C only) - Candidate B relies entirely on the semantic judge's own reading of numeric fields in the Evidence block
multi_evidence_logic: single Cerebras call receives all cited Evidence together, judges sufficiency holistically per contract Section 6
known_accepted_limitations: Benchmark scale (36 claim-level cases) is smaller than the suggested 60-case target - a first Phase-7 benchmark, not claimed as equivalent statistical power
No genuinely independent (different-provider) evaluator was validated in this cloud session - see CTL item for cross-model validation
Evaluator and generator share the same model family (qwen-3.8-27b) - documented as a caveat everywhere, never described as cross-model validation
